about: stopwatch's application mutants; each is judged by the example's tests, laws and cases (scripts/examples), not by a compiler test.

mutants.name: fk1-tick-never-armed
mutants.from:
case Running:
		Some{machines.Every[Signal]{In: TickEvery, Signal: tickedAt}}
mutants.rule: The Running state owns the tick: its entry arms Ticked after TickEvery.

mutants.name: fk1-start-while-running-reenters
mutants.from:
case (Running, Start), (Stopped, Stop), (Starting, Stop), (Stopping, Start):
		Ignore
mutants.to:
case (Running as r, Start):
		Enter[Watch]{Next: Running{Before: r.Elapsed, Since: at, Elapsed: r.Elapsed}}
	case (Stopped, Stop), (Starting, Stop), (Stopping, Start):
		Ignore
mutants.rule: A start while running keeps the entry: restarting the run from the shown time would lose the clock's time since the last tick (law ShownIsClockElapsed).

mutants.name: fk1-stop-zeros
mutants.from:
case (Running as r, Stop):
		Enter[Watch]{Next: Stopped{Elapsed: r.Before + at.Sub(r.Since)}}

mutants.name: fk1-stop-keeps-last-tick
mutants.origin: wf10/fk1a (orchestrator: shown time equals clock elapsed)
mutants.from:
case (Running as r, Stop):
		Enter[Watch]{Next: Stopped{Elapsed: r.Before + at.Sub(r.Since)}}
mutants.to:
case (Running as r, Stop):
		Enter[Watch]{Next: Stopped{Elapsed: r.Elapsed}}
mutants.rule: Stop keeps its reading: a stopped watch shows the time it ran, not the time of its last tick (upstream's form, which loses the time after a late tick).

mutants.name: fk1-tick-counts
mutants.origin: wf10/fk1a (orchestrator: shown time equals clock elapsed)
mutants.from: Running{Before: r.Before, Since: r.Since, Elapsed: r.Before + t.At.Sub(r.Since)}
mutants.to: Running{Before: r.Before, Since: r.Since, Elapsed: r.Elapsed + TickEvery + t.At.Sub(t.At)}
mutants.rule: A tick shows the clock's elapsed time, never one more interval: a late or bunched tick must not lose or add time (round 1's tick count).

mutants.name: fk1-reset-keeps-time
mutants.rule: Reset is the initial watch from any state (the press's arm).

mutants.name: fk1-format-cents
mutants.rule: The shown hundredths are the milliseconds of the second over ten, rounded down.

mutants.name: fk1-format-minutes-wrap
mutants.rule: Minutes are whole minutes, not wrapped at an hour, as upstream's formatTime (law FormatReadsBack).

mutants.name: fk1b-running-shows-start
mutants.rule: A running watch shows Stop, not Start (case laps).

mutants.name: fk1b-no-reset
mutants.rule: The screen always shows Reset (cases idle and laps).

mutants.name: fk1b-time-not-shown-elapsed
mutants.rule: The screen shows the watch's time (case laps).

mutants.name: fkg1-tick-reads-start
mutants.from: func tickedAt(at time.Time) Signal { Ticked{At: at} }
mutants.to: func tickedAt(at time.Time) Signal { Ticked{At: time.Unix(0, 0)} }
mutants.rule: A tick carries the reading it fired at (machines.Every), so a running watch shows the clock's time at its last tick.

mutants.name: fkg1g5-start-click-forgets-the-time
mutants.from:
case (Stopped as st, Start):
		Enter[Watch]{Next: Starting{Elapsed: st.Elapsed}}
mutants.rule: A click of Start waits from the time the watch shows (law ClickThenWorkIsThePress).

mutants.name: fkg1g5-starting-reads-a-stop
mutants.rule: The work of a Start click sends the press of Start (law ClickThenWorkIsThePress).

mutants.name: fkg1g5-stopping-has-no-work
mutants.rule: A click of Stop is answered by a work that reads the clock (law ClickThenWorkIsThePress).

mutants.name: fkg1g5-stop-keeps-the-last-tick
mutants.from:
case (Stopping as r, Stop):
		Enter[Watch]{Next: Stopped{Elapsed: r.Before + at.Sub(r.Since)}}
mutants.to:
case (Stopping as r, Stop):
		Enter[Watch]{Next: Stopped{Elapsed: r.Elapsed}}
mutants.rule: A stop's reading, from the work, sets the time, not the last tick (law ClickThenWorkIsThePress).
